hints.title: Composite Key Concatenation
hints.text: Combine every suffix of a word with its prefix separated by a delimiter to evaluate joint boundary queries with a single prefix lookup.

hints.title: Wrapped Suffix-Word Insertion
hints.text: For each word at index i and each suffix of length L, insert suffix + "{" + word into the tree. Store index i at each visited node.

hints.title: WordFilter Query Blueprint
hints.text: In f(pref, suff): search for query suff + "{" + pref in the tree. If found, return the maximum index stored at that terminal node; otherwise return -1.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N * L^2) build, O(P + S) query
complexity.notes: Every word inserts L suffixes of length up to 2L; queries traverse P + S characters in O(P + S) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning all words on every query takes O(N * L) resulting in query timeout.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Trading quadratic length tree insertions for fast O(P + S) query time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of suffix + delimiter + word concatenation to collapse 2D query into 1D prefix.
